name: 清华大学
character: The heavily wooded campus blends traditional Chinese imperial gardens and ponds with American-style red-brick historical buildings in the west and Soviet-style and modern white buildings in the east.

landmarks.name: 二校门
landmarks.quote: 仿制文艺复兴券柱式大门的新校门（今二校门）

landmarks.name: 大礼堂
landmarks.quote: 大礼堂也是红砖外墙，入口处有大理石柱廊
landmarks.look: Red-brick auditorium with a marble colonnade at the entrance.

landmarks.name: 图书馆
landmarks.quote: 图书馆室内则采用磨光花岗石装饰
landmarks.look: American university-style library with polished granite interior.

landmarks.name: 清华学堂
landmarks.quote: 一院（今清华学堂西半部）
landmarks.look: Two-story brick-and-wood hall in German classical style.

landmarks.name: 科学馆
landmarks.quote: 科学馆为红色砖墙，屋顶铺设石板瓦
landmarks.look: Red-brick hall with a slate-tiled roof.

landmarks.name: 工字厅
landmarks.quote: 原王府庭园工字厅、古月堂、水木清华等古建筑

landmarks.name: 荷花池
landmarks.quote: 朱自清先生在《荷塘月色》中描述的“荷花池”（近春园遗址）

landmarks.name: 艺术博物馆
landmarks.quote: 主楼的东侧则有美术学院、环境节能楼、艺术博物馆
